# Cybrum Solutions

> Cybrum Solutions is an AI-native company based in Karachi, Pakistan, building
> AI agents, automation, custom chatbots, and web systems for clients in
> Pakistan and worldwide, delivered end to end by one accountable team. The
> founder is Ahmed Raza. Every engagement starts with a free AI audit that
> maps the client's workflow and gives an honest recommendation on what is
> worth automating.

## Services

- [Automation & AI Agents](https://www.cybrumsolutions.dev/services/ai-automation): Multi-agent systems (LangGraph, CrewAI), n8n workflow automation, document/data processing, and lead handling. A single workflow ships in 1-2 weeks; multi-agent systems in 4-8 weeks.
- [Custom Chatbots & Assistants](https://www.cybrumsolutions.dev/services/ai-chatbots): Domain-specific AI assistants with memory and tool access, grounded in a business's real documents and data, for websites, WhatsApp, or internal use. Ships in 2-4 weeks.
- [Web Development](https://www.cybrumsolutions.dev/services/web-development): Fast, SEO-ready websites and web applications on Next.js, with technical SEO, structured data, and analytics built in. Marketing sites ship in 2-3 weeks.

## Products

- [CS Chatbot](https://www.cybrumsolutions.dev/products/chatbot): An AI chatbot product for a business's website and WhatsApp Business number, trained only on that business's own content, answering with source citations. Also documented at https://chatbot.cybrumsolutions.dev/llms.txt.

## Frequently asked questions

- **What is the difference between an AI agent and a chatbot?** A chatbot answers questions in a conversation. An AI agent reasons about a goal, uses tools, and completes real tasks like updating systems, sending emails, or processing orders.
- **How much does AI automation or an AI agent cost?** A single automated workflow is usually a few hundred dollars. Custom chatbots and assistants typically run into the low thousands. Multi-agent systems are quoted per project after a free AI audit.
- **How long does it take to build and deploy?** A focused automation workflow ships in 1-2 weeks, a custom chatbot or assistant in 2-4 weeks, and larger multi-agent systems in 4-8 weeks.
- **Which tools and platforms does Cybrum Solutions build with?** Claude API, LangGraph, CrewAI, and n8n for agents and automation, plus Next.js and Python for web systems. Clients own all the code and infrastructure.
- **Does Cybrum Solutions work with international clients?** Yes. The company is based in Karachi, Pakistan, and serves clients worldwide, delivered remotely with systems deployed into the client's own accounts.
